# Get Date/Time String

![Get Date/Time String function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/timestamp/02-get-date-time-string.svg)

[Timestamp functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Optional scalar Timestamp or real number (current time if omitted), date format and seconds flag produce date and time Strings in the computer time zone. Runtime support depends on the selected execution target.
